reviews.text:
I took my pet to get groomed. I just wanted his belly shaved and hind legs trimmed. However, during the service, they called and asked for a further shaved look, which they highly recommended my pet needed in order to rectify their mistake of shaving more than what I wanted. When I got him back, my beautiful boy looked SO shockingly different. I was and still am SO upset.
That said, they seem to offer good services for their regular clients. If you must take your pet here, and you are a new client, I thoroughly recommend staying there.
Don't leave your pet unattended like I did, which is a mistake on my part.

We've been going to Bloomingtails and working with Ren for about 6 years. Ren always does such a good job on our 17 year old puppy. Ren is understanding of her heart condition so she accommodates to make things less stressful for her. Our puppy has always been anxious around groomers but she is much calmer with Ren.
The workers are all really great and they really take their time with my phoebe - would recommend to anyone.
Seriously recommend Ren for all your grooming needs! She’s so good with the animals. I take my two cats & dog to her all the time. I never have to worry about my pets when they’re with her!

What to start of by saying a big thanks to Ren who took care of my cat and gave him the best 2 hours of her time to care for my 7 year old Bentley, the lion cut and wash came out amazing and what matters the most is that the cat came home stress free. Definitely will be returning for future cuts! Definitely recommend this place for anyone looking to groom their animals!

Another groomer canceled on my last minute, and the kind staff here fit me in! They were gracious and understanding, and took a very messy, overgrown cocker spaniel and turned him into the little tidy gentleman I know him to be! Affordable, kind, great groomers - can’t ask for anything more!
Went to get both my dogs groomed & the groomer slit my dog.. never coming back.

Dana and Bloomingtales are the best!!  They take great care of my cocker spaniel’s grooming needs. I never have one complaint ever !  It’s easy to get an appointment and everyone is very friendly.  I’ll never go anywhere else.

Amazing SKILLS
Wonderful caring people
Going there 8 years never disappointed
Great place. Friendly and professional.  Prices are fare but most of all your pups in great hands. And to.me.thats more then anything.

This was our first visit with Dana, and she was so nice and welcoming!
My dog is very anxious around loud noises and new places and she handled her with ease and care 🖤
Definitely will be coming back

this is the best groomer on Staten island especially Josephine once u go to her I will never find another groomer she is so.good with her dogs my Max loved her and she is the only one who knows how to cut hair for a Maltese the place is very friendly and Carol the receptionist is very pleasant so if u need a good groomer there is the place to go
Very helpful and took care of my dog! she's 15 years old and was helped with great care to keep her calm and relaxed.

Jo is the only one who can cut my dog’s fur and he can be extremely difficult.  She’s very kind, patient and accommodating.  Other groomers have turned my dog away but she goes the extra mile to make sure he’s taken care of.  Highly recommend!

I love Bloomingtales. Staff members are very nice, kind and patient. I don't trust my dogs to many, and many doesn't want to deal with my dogs. They are complicated. Angel handles them with love and patience, he is amazing! Price is also very reasonable. And now they have hilarious cookies that my dogs loved! Thank you, Bloomingtales Grooming! ❤️
The best groomers in staten island.

I have used just about every groomer on Staten Island and Bloomingtails is by far the superior groomer. They have excellent staff who are kind and courteous and they take great care of our furry friends. I highly recommend this groomer.
I love Bloomingtails!  They are great ! My groomer Ren is amazing! My goldendoodle Kylie loves her and she always takes best care of my Kylie.
They did a great job for my dog. The groomers are very caring and excellent with my pet. Very highly recommended.

My big Black English Labrador, CHAOS, had the BEST Bath, Deshedding treatment and Grooming he has had in his entire 4 years of life.  He was treated like the King he is (at least in our household) and spoiled very much so.  He cannot wait to visit with Ren, his prior groomer, this coming week.  Honestly, I gave up on all of the other groomers...this place is the BEST!

Suzanne is amazing! She’s patient, professional, and truly cares about the dogs she grooms. My pup always comes back looking clean, happy, and adorable. You can tell she loves what she does — highly recommend
Such a wonderful experience. They listened and delivered exactly what I wanted for my pup
My daughter's dog had problems at all few places, and we brought it to this place. No problem, and literally the best haircut.My dog has had, i highly recommend this place.
These guys are awesome! We recently moved here and have been looking for a good dog groomer. Safe to say we found the one! Not only did our dog look good, but also smelled amazing!

Bloomingtails is my favorite grooming spot on SI! Dana is absolutely fantastic and she handled my husky in the most professional and caring manner. My baby is difficult to groom (he hates water), but Dana was very knowledgable on how to groom my husky and still show him love. I will absolutely take my dog back to her and will be referring her to all my friends/family!

At first I thought this place was great. Angel did a great job of grooming my beautiful Husky. But the 2nd time I took him to get groomed my poor boy urinated on the floor when he saw Angel walking toward him. I thought he just didn’t like baths until my husband told me that was a sign of fear. I took him to a different groomer and my poor boy became aggressive toward the groomer and wouldn’t let her near him. He has NEVER behaved that way toward anyone! I truly believe Angel mistreated my poor baby and now I can’t take him anywhere to get groomed. I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS PLACE!

I’m so so happy. My baby was nervous and this was her first official haircut. Everyone was so sweet in there and Josephine was amazing and patient with her. I put before and after pics to show the difference. I’m so thankful :)

Review for Bloomingtails Grooming –  and Dana, the Owner

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently brought my dog to Bloomingtails Grooming, and I couldn’t be more thrilled with the experience! Dana, the owner, is truly a gem in the world of pet grooming. From the moment we walked in, it was clear that she and her team genuinely care about their furry clients.
Highlights of My Experience:

Exceptional Customer Service: Dana took the time to understand my dog’s specific needs and temperament. She listened patiently to my requests and made sure I felt confident in the care they would provide.

Professionalism and Skill: My dog has never looked better! Dana’s grooming skills are top-notch. Every detail, from the perfectly trimmed coat to the adorable finishing touches, was done with precision and care.

Gentle and Caring Approach: My pup can be a bit nervous in new environments, but Dana’s calm and friendly demeanor put him right at ease. It’s clear she has a natural way with animals, and my dog came out happy and relaxed—a rarity after grooming appointments elsewhere!

Clean and Welcoming Environment: The salon was spotless and smelled fresh, which was reassuring. Dana has created a space that’s inviting for both pets and their owners.

Personal Touches: Dana goes above and beyond to make her services feel special. Whether it’s a cute bandana or a spritz of dog-friendly cologne, these little details show how much she cares.

I highly recommend Dana and her team at Bloomingtails Grooming to any pet parent who wants their dog treated with love, care, and professionalism. We’ve already booked our next appointment and can’t wait to visit again.

Thank you, Dana, for your incredible work and dedication
Dom Michele and Asher

I can’t say enough good things about Bloomingtales Grooming! Ren is amazing and so super sweet.  She has been grooming my dog for almost two years now and every time we leave, she looks and smells amazing and so cute with her little bandana and bows.

They are always professional, kind, and reliable, and the space is clean and welcoming. Whether you need a simple bath or a full groom you won’t be disappointed, I always feel like my pup is in the best hands.

I Highly recommend to any dog parent who wants quality grooming with heart!

I been taking my poodle here for years now. We go to Ren (Lauren). she is absolutely amazing and takes the best care of my girl. My dog is super fluffy, gets knots and all that good stuff. She always takes her time and my Holly always comes out looking amazing !!

My Maui has been getting groomed at bloomingtails his whole life(he’s almost 3) Ren grooms him and she ALWAYS does an amazing job!!!!! I can’t recommend them enough! I always leave so happy with how my Maui looks! 10/10 recommend!
I absolutely love the staff here. My pups are comfortable too. They always come out exactly how I requested their cuts to be

This is the place to go to! I'm a little crazy with my dogs, and I would trust ANY of the staff there with all four for my babies. Everyone there is wonderful and so talented! the hair cuts never seem to come out as good anywhere else I've tried, and I've tried many. They are knowledgable, honest, and patient. They truly care about safety and cleanliness. I'll never go anywhere else. A true diamond in the rough if you ask me!!!
Friendly welcoming. REN did a great job on my dog Jak. He was happy and so was I.

my family brought our german shepherd to get groomed the other day. his hindquarters are usually quite fluffy but for some reason they took mass amounts of his hair off. they shaved down his legs entirely, and even his under area. it’s uncomfortable and the dog is even bothered by the lack of fur there. he looks like two different dogs and it seems like they got lazy when it came to that part of him. the only upside would be that his paws are beautifully done.
Dana is amazing! They’re always accommodating get me in as soon as possible! The groom is always on point. Love the cute photos and holiday attire
It was a last minute decision to get him groomed and he looks so great. They got me in the same day. They were so patient with him and did such a great job.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

We absolutely love Blooming Tails! Dana is truly incredible, and her passion for what she does shines through in every detail. As soon as we arrive, Asher is met with so much care and kindness—it feels like a second home for him. Dana has an incredible way of making dogs (and their owners!) feel comfortable and valued.

Asher always comes out looking amazing, smelling great, and wagging his tail like he just had the best spa day ever. Dana takes the time to understand each dog’s unique needs, and her gentle touch makes the entire experience stress-free. The attention to detail and professionalism is unmatched.

We’re so grateful for Dana and the entire Blooming Tails team. Thank you for always taking such wonderful care of Asher. We wouldn’t trust anyone else! Their like family to us

Asher 🐾

Bloomingtails Grooming is by far the best spot in Staten Island to get your pets groomed. They took such great care of my girls. Dana handled my dogs just as if they were her own. If you are looking for a skilled groomer and excellent service! I highly recommend Dana and all of the other groomers at Bloomingtails Grooming!!!

There’s are no word!!!! Just amazing staff and amazing experience I ever had with a grommer service were will  call you family now your the best we love you ANGEL thank you for making bleu happy again and the picture of his Christmas photo shoot was awesome we r super super happy with the services ❤️

This place is wonderful.

It was so easy and fast.

The staff was very nice and attentive.

This review is long overdue! I’ve had the absolute pleasure of bringing my two Aussies, Rabil and Duck, to Bloomingtails in Staten Island, and I am consistently impressed by the exceptional level of care and professionalism. …

This place is a must go for Grooming services if you have a fur baby!  I brought my Ella there for the first time and I’m so very happy to say we finally found our groomer and will be returning!. Josephine gave her the most beautiful …

I know the owner Josephine for 20 years. She groomed my last dog for 14 yrs, and now has been grooming my dog  for almost 4 yrs. She's friendly, compassionate, professional and the price is good. Her place is immaculate as well!!  I recommend Bloomingtails to friends and strangers as well!!

I love it here!!!!! Customer service is always amazing and Angel is the best when it comes to treating my Yorkie. Everyone is such a pleasure and nice to talk and answers every question and concern you may have! Will 100% recommend to everyone!
Excellent customer service. Very friendly and respectful people. My two dogs love them
